note: Example: voice block 01 of video 001 (the hook) redrawn in the stickman-v1 style. Numbers, labels and charts are drawn later by Remotion, so scenes leave room for them where needed.

shots.vo: Rent takes about 30 percent of a typical young worker's paycheck.
shots.scene: WORKER stands on the left and presents the empty right side of the room to the viewer.
shots.camera: medium wide shot at eye level

characters.name: WORKER
characters.facing: the viewer, body turned slightly right

shots.vo: That's right where the government starts calling it a burden.
shots.scene: WORKER balances in the middle of the tightrope, looking down nervously.

shots.vo: So rent must have outrun pay, right?
shots.scene: RENT runs ahead on the right side of the track, confident; PAY runs behind on the left, struggling.
shots.camera: wide side view of the track

shots.vo: Over the last seven years, not exactly.
shots.scene: PAY passes RENT just before the finish line on the right; RENT looks surprised.
shots.camera: wide side view of the track

shots.vo: But there's one stretch where it did.
shots.scene: The empty track; WORKER stands at the edge and studies one middle stretch of the track.
WORKER waves at the viewer in front of a small apartment building, a compact car parked nearby.
shots.camera: medium wide shot at eye level

shots.vo: Full time, aged 25 to 34, earning about $60,000 a year before tax.
shots.scene: WORKER proudly holds up a blank paycheck on the left of the frame.

shots.vo: Hand them the national median rent, and it takes about 30 percent of that pay...
shots.scene: WORKER presents the empty right side of the room, looking a little worried.
shots.camera: medium wide shot at eye level

characters.name: WORKER
characters.facing: the viewer, body turned slightly right

shots.vo: That uses 2026 pay and 2024 rent... so call it a rough benchmark.
shots.scene: WORKER shrugs next to the kitchen table; two blank wall calendars hang behind, one on each side.

shots.vo: And in 2024, about half of U.S. renter households, of all ages, were over H-U-D's line.
shots.scene: One small neighbour stands in front of each of the eight houses.
shots.background_people: eight small neighbours of different ages, one in front of each house; about half of them look worried, the others calm
shots.camera: wide shot of the whole row of houses

shots.vo: Different group, so it does not grade our worker.
shots.scene: Close-up of WORKER raising one eyebrow at the viewer.
shots.camera: close-up of the head and shoulders on the left of the frame

shots.vo: So, is a normal life affordable on a typical paycheck?
shots.scene: WORKER sits at the kitchen table thinking, bills and a calculator in front of them.

shots.vo: On rent alone, our worker sits about at the line.
shots.scene: WORKER balances on the tightrope, steadier than before.

shots.vo: Here is how that number gets built, where rent pulled ahead, and what it cannot tell you.
shots.scene: WORKER points toward a wooden signpost with three blank arrow signs on the right.
